claims: The Oscars are held at the Dolby Theatre in Ovation Hollywood (formerly Hollywood & Highland) on Hollywood Boulevard in Los Angeles, California.
The Dolby Theatre has hosted the annual Academy Awards ceremony since 2001.
The Dolby Theatre is contracted to host the Academy Awards ceremony through 2028.
The Dolby Theatre is located at Hollywood Boulevard and Highland Avenue, Hollywood, California.
The Dolby Theatre is a purpose-built venue for the Academy Awards.
The Dolby Theatre is adjacent to the historic TCL Chinese Theatre.
The Dolby Theatre is surrounded by the Ovation Hollywood shopping center.
The Academy Awards ceremony occasionally takes place at other venues in Los Angeles.
The Dolby Theatre is considered the primary, consistent home of the Oscars
